title: catalyst share push
description: What `catalyst share push --yes --json` prints: what it published. git publishes commits on a topic branch and opens a pull request; serve publishes a batch of files. `commits` is 0 when there was nothing to publish.

commits.description: git: the commits pushed; serve: the files published.

pull_request.description: git: the pull request's URL, when one was opened.

pull_request_note.description: git: why no pull request was opened.

regenerated.description: The generated files rewritten before publishing.
